title: #76 Lars Stenlund on Driven by Curiosity

reader_summary.headline: Hello everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by RedEye.
reader_summary.overview: Hello everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by RedEye. I'm your host, Edie Palmen, and today we're thrilled to have Lars Stenlund on the show. In 1985, Lars co-founded Vitek Software in Umeå, a city in northern Sweden, with 130,000 inhabitants.

key_points.text: Still, headquartered in Umeå, Vitek is today a large cap company listed at Nasdaq.com with a market cap of about $1.5 billion.
key_points.evidence_quote: Still, headquartered in Umeå, Vitek is today a large cap company listed at Nasdaq.com with a market cap of about $1.5 billion.

key_points.text: Lars Stenlund was born in 1958 and was the CEO of Vitek for 35 years.
key_points.evidence_quote: Lars Stenlund was born in 1958 and was the CEO of Vitek for 35 years.

key_points.text: Since 2021, he's the chairman of the board and remains one of the largest shareholders with 19% of the votes.
key_points.evidence_quote: Since 2021, he's the chairman of the board and remains one of the largest shareholders with 19% of the votes.

Celebrating Vitek's 40th anniversary in 2025, the company and author Patrick Suleian compiled a book about a remarkable journey from a small venture at Umeå University to becoming a leading company in vertical software solutions.

thesis: The podcast features Lars Stenlund, chairman of Vitek Software, discussing his book 'Driven by Curiosity,' which documents the company's 40-year journey from a small venture at Umeå University to a leading provider of vertical software solutions. Stenlund attributes his career path and the company's founding to his enduring curiosity, noting that he spent 22 years in school while remaining curious and that he and his co-founders identified curiosity as their driving force rather than a specific long-term plan.
